ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. The Role: AMD is seeking a talented Physical AI researcher to join our team focused on simulation and AI for robotics using AMD technologies. The role centers on training, inference and simulation for robotics of vision-language-action (VLA) models and world action models (WAMs). Additionally, the role includes an active tracking and evaluation of physical AI trends to help guide AMD's technology and product direction. You will join a dynamic, high-impact group where we create innovative solutions to complex technical challenges and demonstrate their feasibility through proof-of-concept outputs. We work closely with AMD product groups to transition the technologies we develop into products that enhance our customers' success. We also foster community growth with external partners through open-source projects and academic research collaborations. The Person: As researchers, we present our work internally and externally and have numerous opportunities to collaborate with industrial and academic partners. You will be a technical evangelist for physical AI, comfortable presenting to both deeply technical audiences and customers. We regularly patent our inventions and publish our research. Additionally, we are expected to explore and assess new technologies with the aim of integrating the most valuable ones into the company. We are committed to continuous learning! The successful candidate will receive close mentorship at AMD and will expand their technical expertise across a diverse set of domains at AMD. Does this describe you? If so, join us! Key Responsibilities: Develop and apply digital twin workflows to train, evaluate, and benchmark physical AI models, including synthetic data generation and sim-to-real transfer. Evaluate, adapt, and optimize VLA models and WAMs for robotic applications on AMD GPU platforms. Track, analyze, and report on trends in physical AI, including new models, simulators, datasets, benchmarks, and the competitive landscape, and translate findings into recommendations for AMD research and product roadmaps. Characterize physical AI workloads (model training, inference, simulation, and rendering) on AMD GPUs and use findings to guide future hardware and GPU software design. Present research findings, demonstrations, and technical direction to internal technical teams and to external customers and partners. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, product groups, and external partners to integrate physical AI models and simulation capabilities into AMD's robotics solutions. Contribute to open-source software projects and engage with the physical AI developer community. Publish and patent research results. Preferred Experience: In-depth knowledge of and hands-on experience with vision-language-action (VLA) models and world action models (WAMs) for robotics. Hands-on experience with simulation for robotics and physical AI, such as Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or similar physics-based simulators, including building simulation environments for training and evaluating models. Strong knowledge of GPU architectures and GPU software stacks, including performance profiling and optimization. Active participation in open-source projects, GitHub repository maintenance, and a record of publications or patents is desirable. Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Academic Credentials: Ph.D. in AI, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, plus at least 5 years of relevant research or industry experience. Location: Longmont, CO This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. #LI-DP1 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
